title: Uses a Boolean value to indicate whether it can be cleared
goal: Provides a Boolean value to the "Clear" button based on whether the memo box already contains characters.
summary: Boolean values are only true and false. Boolean Converts an empty string to false and any non-empty string to true.
tasks: Check the string note passed in the note box in the curly brackets of canClearNote. As long as there are characters in the box, even if there is only one space, it can be cleared.
uses return to return a Boolean value. Returns false if there is no input in the box, and returns true in other cases.
hint: Check the returned type. Return note directly will hand over the note content, and Boolean(note) will get a Boolean value.

example.note: The reservation page uses the number of seats to get the Boolean value of whether there are seats available. A value of 0 is converted to false, and a positive number is converted to true.
